correctness.rationale: The positional embedding triples are exactly 1≤i≤j<k≤n. When i=j the output is v_(k−1); when i<j and k=j+1 it is v_i. These disjoint types give t and n−1−t realizations of v_t. The v_t have no 00, and are distinguished by their initial 1 or the position of their unique 11. In the separated case the unique 00 at output position 2j−2 identifies j; the following 11 at 2k−4 identifies k; and the preceding 11 at 2i−2, or its absence when i=1, identifies i. These defects remain distinct at the smallest gaps. Thus choosing i,j,k−1 gives exactly binom(n−1,3) singletons and no further case. The n=3 edge case has two double fibers, and reverse-complement preserves the host and swaps the patterns. I independently enumerated literal three-position combinations for both patterns for n=3..25 and recovered the spectrum and mirror bijection; the universal proof does not depend on that finite check.
